name: Italy
note: Italian formations of the Kingdom of Italy (folder italy). Added 15 November 2026 with the nation_allegiance table. **Split between IT and RSI (15 November 2026; a convention for Scott to confirm):** IT is the King's forces, that is the Regio Esercito, Regia Marina and Regia Aeronautica up to the armistice of 8 September 1943 (Axis, then neutral gap) and the co-belligerent forces of the Kingdom from 13 October 1943; RSI is the forces of the Italian Social Republic proclaimed on 23 September 1943 (its republican army, navy, air force and party and police formations). A formation that exists on both sides of the split keeps its IT record up to 8 September 1943 and an RSI re-formation gets its own RSI record with a lineage link, as with other redesignations (no source of the dataset names one yet). The dated sides are in data/nation_allegiance.csv. No unit yet.
